SpardaECFixes — install guide
==============================

A small mod for Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes (Steam) with several toggleable
quality-of-life fixes, including:
  - Organize your party at any save point (not just the base camp)
  - Permanent +100% collection point bonus
  - Large-size units take 1 party slot instead of 2
  - Attack any enemy from any row (your side only — enemies keep normal rules)
  - Equip any gear on any character, including shields

1) Prerequisite: BepInEx
------------------------
You need BepInEx (the IL2CPP build) already installed for this game. If you're not
sure, check whether your game folder already has a "BepInEx" subfolder — if it does,
you're set. If not, get BepInEx here first and follow its own install instructions:

    https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases

(grab a release tagged "IL2CPP" for your platform — this game is IL2CPP, not Mono).

2) Install this mod
--------------------
Copy the "plugins" folder from this package into your game's "BepInEx" folder, merging
it with what's already there. When done, you should have:

    <your game folder>\BepInEx\plugins\SpardaECFixes\SpardaECFixes.dll

3) First launch
----------------
Launch the game once. This generates a settings file at:

    <your game folder>\BepInEx\config\sparda.eiyudenchronicle.ecfixes.cfg

Open that file in any text editor to see every fix with a description and its current
on/off setting (true/false). Most fixes need a game restart to take effect after you
change them — each one's description says whether it does.

Nothing this mod does touches your save files — only in-game behavior while running.

4) Known issues (be aware before reporting a bug)
---------------------------------------------------
  - "AlwaysHaveRohanHealBonus" (heal a % of HP after every battle) is not yet confirmed
    working — testing suggests the patch applies without error but may not actually be
    healing. Leave it off (false) unless you want to help test it.
  - "DefaultSupportUnitWhenBlank" is confirmed NOT working currently — leave it off.
  - "RandomSupportSkillsAlwaysActivate" is disabled by default pending further testing.
  - Everything else (party formation, collection bonus, large units, row attacks, equip
    anything) has been tested and confirmed working across multiple play sessions.

If something seems broken, checking BepInEx\LogOutput.log for lines starting with
"[SpardaECFixes]" usually explains what happened — every fix in this mod fails safe
(logs an error and changes nothing) rather than guessing when it can't find what it's
looking for.
